title: Maximum Likelihood on the Joint (Data, Condition) Distribution for Solving Ill-Posed Problems with Conditional Flow Models
abstract: arXiv:2208.11782v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the absence of conditioning information, normalizing flow models are trained using maximum likelihood. Previous extensions to conditional settings have abandoned the simple maximum-likelihood approach, as obtaining the full joint distribution of data and conditions for training purposes (or equivalently, the true conditional distribution for each point in the training dataset) is impossible. However, under special conditions that nevertheless apply to a wide class of useful problems, it is possible to obtain a simple, computationally cheap proxy with the same global minimum as the conditional likelihood. Conditional flow models trained using this proxy do not require explicit knowledge of the conditional distribution, auxiliary networks or other specific architecture, or additional loss terms beyond maximum likelihood. They provide a natural and powerful way to solve a class of ill-posed inverse problems. I demonstrate these prope

translated_title: 基于数据与条件联合分布的最大似然方法：利用条件流模型求解不适定问题
translated_abstract: 在缺乏条件信息的情况下，归一化流模型使用最大似然进行训练。以往对条件化设置的扩展放弃了简单的最大似然方法，因为为了训练而获取数据与条件的完整联合分布（或等价地，获取训练数据集中每个点的真实条件分布）是不可能的。然而，在适用于一大类有用问题的特殊条件下，可以获得一个简单且计算成本低廉的代理方法，其全局最小值与条件似然相同。使用该代理方法训练的条件流模型不需要显式了解条件分布，不需要辅助网络或其他特定架构，也不需要在最大似然之外的额外损失项。它们为求解一类不适定逆问题提供了一种自然且强大的方法。我演示了这些特性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种计算低成本的最大似然代理方法来训练条件流模型，无需显式条件分布、辅助网络或额外损失项，即可自然地求解一类不适定逆问题。
en_tdlr: A simple, computationally cheap maximum-likelihood proxy enables training conditional flow models to naturally solve a class of ill-posed inverse problems without requiring explicit conditional distributions, auxiliary networks, or additional loss terms.
